1.title: Information Extraction with Content Understanding
1.text: Welcome to Module twelve: Information Extraction with Content Understanding. It covers the exam area Implement A I solutions by using Microsoft Foundry. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do five things. Extract information from documents and forms by using Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools. Extract information from images by using Content Understanding. Extract information from audio and video by using Content Understanding. Build a lightweight application with information extraction capabilities by using Content Understanding. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: Implement A I solutions by using Microsoft Foundry (fifty-five to sixty percent). Exam format: a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes; check the exam page for the time. Validated against: the official A I nine oh one study guide, current skills measured.

1.title: What Content Understanding does
1.text: What Content Understanding does. Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools is a Foundry Tool that "uses generative A I to process and ingest many types of content, including documents, images, videos and audio" into a user-defined output format. A document or form (P D F, scan, image of a page). Text, layout, and fields such as invoice number, date, total. An image. A summary and fields you define. Audio (a call recording). A transcript, a summary, speaker labels. Video. Key frames, a transcript, chapter segments. The output is Markdown (good for search and retrieval) or Jason that matches the schema you define.

1.title: What Content Understanding does, continued
1.text: What Content Understanding does. The figure shows this: One service, four kinds of content, structured output.

1.title: Analyzers
1.text: Analyzers. An analyzer is the recipe that says what to extract from a type of content. Prebuilt analyzer. Ready-made for common scenarios; names include prebuilt invoice for invoices, and search analyzers for images ( image Search ), video ( video Search ) and audio ( audio Search ). Custom analyzer. One you design for your own content, with your own fields. Exam tip: "Common document type such as an invoice" to prebuilt analyzer. "Our own form with our own fields" to custom analyzer.

1.title: Extracting from documents and forms
1.text: Extracting from documents and forms. Content extraction reads the content: O C R text, selection marks (check boxes), barcodes, formulas and the layout (paragraphs, sections, tables). Field extraction returns the values you ask for. Three ways to get a value. Extract. Meaning: Take the value exactly as it appears (documents only). Example: The invoice total printed on the page. Classify. Meaning: Choose a category from a list. Example: "Invoice", "Receipt" or "Contract". Generate. Meaning: Write a value with generative A I. Example: A one-sentence summary. Two quality features. Confidence score: a number from zero to one for each extracted field: how reliable it is. Use it to send low-confidence values to a person to check.

1.title: Extracting from documents and forms, continued
1.text: Extracting from documents and forms. Grounding: shows where in the document each value was found. Exam tip: A low confidence score means the value may be wrong, so a person should check it.

1.title: Extracting from images, audio and video
1.text: Extracting from images, audio and video. Image ( image Search ). A summary field. Audio ( audio Search ). Transcript, summary, speaker labeling. Video ( video Search ). Key frames, transcript, chapter segments. This makes recordings and videos searchable and lets an app pull out specific facts, for example action items from a meeting recording. For custom needs you add your own fields to a custom analyzer. for the current analyzers.

1.title: A lightweight extraction application
1.text: A lightweight extraction application. The pattern is again client, one call, read the result. Analysis can take time, so the call is a long-running operation that returns a poller you wait on. The example is on the screen; read it line by line when you study.

1.title: A lightweight extraction application, continued
1.text: A lightweight extraction application. pip install the pre flag azure ai contentunderstanding. The package (a pre-release at the time of writing). os dot environ... Endpoint and key come from environment variables. Content Understanding Client... The client for the service. begin analyze analyzer id..., inputs... Starts the analysis with a chosen analyzer on an input (here a U R L). poller dot result. Waits and returns the analysis result: fields, confidence, content. Use A P I version two thousand twenty-five to eleven to one (generally available) for production; a preview version has newer features. Exam tip: "begin " in the method name means a long-running operation: you get a poller and call result. The analyzer id chooses what is extracted. Change the analyzer to change the type of content or fields.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Fabrikam Outdoors receives thousands of supplier invoices as P D Fs and wants invoice number, date and total as fields. Which option fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Content Understanding with a prebuilt invoice analyzer. A prebuilt invoice analyzer extracts the common invoice fields from documents.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A confidence score of zero point four two is returned for the extracted total. What is a sensible action? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Send the value to a person for review. Low confidence means the value may be wrong, so a person should check it.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A call-center wants transcripts, summaries and speaker labels from recordings. Which kind of analyzer fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: An audio analyzer such as audio Search. The prebuilt audio analyzer returns a transcript, a summary and speaker labels.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which field extraction method copies a value exactly as it appears in a document? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Extract. Extract takes values as they appear; classify chooses a category; generate writes a value.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. In the sample code, what does poller dot result do? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Waits for the analysis and returns the result. begin analyze starts a long-running operation, and result() waits for and returns the outcome.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. A company has its own form with unusual fields and no prebuilt analyzer fits. What should it create? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: A custom analyzer with its own fields. A custom analyzer lets you define your own fields for your own content.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. Which four kinds of content does Content Understanding process? Answer: Documents, images, audio and video. Question two. What are the three field extraction methods? Answer: Extract, classify and generate. Question three. What range does a confidence score have? Answer: zero to one.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What does grounding show? Answer: Where in the content each value was found. Question five. What two output formats are available? Answer: Markdown and Jason matching your schema. Question six. What does a method name starting with begin indicate? Answer: A long-running operation that returns a poller.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Service: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools: documents, images, audio, video. Analyzers: prebuilt (prebuilt-invoice, image Search, audio Search, video Search) or custom. Documents: O C R, selection marks, barcodes, formulas, layout; fields by extract, classify, generate. Quality: confidence zero to one; grounding shows the source region. Output: Markdown (search) or Jason (schema). Code: Content Understanding Client; begin analyze(analyzer id, inputs); poller.result(). In the next module, we continue the course.
